description: The opened casserole report uses qualitative wording (“multiple residents”) across several localities but gives no numeric or site-specific attendance. Do not pool across locations to meet the >=50 threshold.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous site-level attendance counts or reliable descriptions showing >=50 at an individual public gathering.

description: GAB202102-S002 calls Thursday 18 February the second evening; the 17 February onset is inferred as the immediately preceding evening. The first night’s activity and whether it included a qualifying public assembly are not established by an opened source.
required_followup: Verify first-evening date, action type, and whether home-based noise preceded any public street gathering.

description: The report names Libreville, Akanda, Owendo and Port-Gentil as participating areas, and street clashes at PK7, Louis and other neighborhoods, but does not map attendance, public assembly sites, or local event boundaries.
required_followup: Identify exact sites and whether each site independently met the threshold; determine whether a common national call linked them.

description: One local article reports arrests and agents striking detainees with pots, and says shots were heard and people may have died. The article does not identify who fired or confirm deaths; independent confirmations and later government response are not yet body-verified in this unit.
required_followup: Use independently opened reporting or human-rights records to assess shootings, killings, arrests, beatings and subsequent state response separately.

description: Search-only headlines refer to initial casserole mobilization and later arrests, but do not establish whether the February17–18 activity was one continuous event, how later nights relate, or when physical protest ended.
required_followup: Verify each dated gathering and arrest chronology; keep later arrests and publication dates separate from the event’s physical end.

description: The opened article says the casserole action was initiated but names no organizer or explicit common organizing across towns.
required_followup: Check contemporaneous calls/statements for organizers and multi-city coordination; do not infer national organization from multiple locations.

description: Search-only SYNAPEF headlines mention an assembly, strike and arrears; no body verifies the assembly date, public access, attendance, demand target or whether the assembly and work stoppage form one event.
required_followup: Verify the general assembly and any pickets from contemporary sources; distinguish assembly attendance from workforce size and from the strike.

description: SOGATRA results report a multi-week strike and later service resumption, but their bodies were not opened. The onset may fall in January or February, and the February work action must not be treated as a new protest without evidence of a qualifying public assembly.
required_followup: Verify exact strike onset, company-base assemblies, turnout, state/company target, and whether service resumption ended the stoppage but not public activity.

description: The prior Gabon January unit has an opened CONASYSED union statement announcing a February8 stoppage, February22 release and a planned February27 assembly. Current February result cards include related search-only reports, but no current source body verifies whether the assembly occurred or met the public/threshold criteria.
required_followup: Verify occurrence, venue, public access, attendance, actual demands and relationship to the work stoppage before adding an event row; see cross-month source GAB202101-S125.

description: Other headline-only leads include the SNEC-USTM “university dead” day, bakery and COSYGA labor actions, an avoided Total strike, a defused commerce strike, Moutouki seller grievances and bar-owner aid claims. Search headers do not establish qualifying public assemblies.
required_followup: Only add an event if contemporaneous evidence verifies an actual public gathering of >=50 with a demand to Gabon’s government or policy.

description: Open-web searches are discovery coverage, not a LexisNexis reproduction. The 15 logged invocations preserve 360 ordered result headers, but language, indexing, archive and query coverage remain incomplete. Only one opened body is available in this dossier.
required_followup: Coordinator review and any later authorized source work should retain source lineage and keep all uncertain counts, dates, event boundaries and responses explicit.
